answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable bond in a shared kernel contract before trading. Newcomers earn trust slowly, like a lotus opening petal by petal: each completed job returns a slice of the bond plus reputation, while proven fraud forfeits the whole stake. Random audits strike like a sudden gale, checking work against independent peers. An attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity and loses it on the first failed audit, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of bonds while honest agents pay only a temporary deposit.
